page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores of the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz with one thread per core. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

The AMD EPYC processor includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16), AES cryptography extensions, and SHA_NI. In benchmark testing, the server demonstrates top-tier single-core CPU performance, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core tests and the top 25% for Geekbench single-core and text processing workloads. Multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations fall within the average tier.

Given its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, this instance offers high compute density and strong single-threaded performance. The absence of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient choice for CPU-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe drives. It is well-suited for web serving, software compilation, text processing, and general-purpose compute tasks that benefit from high clock speeds and dedicated AMD EPYC cores.
